subject: Cost-steering plan & live-routing runbook for ScubaTech onboarding
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@scubatech.com>, infraops@scubatech.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-16T15:10:00Z
Subject: Cost-steering plan & live-routing runbook for ScubaTech onboarding

Hi Elena / infraops team —

Thanks again for the productive kickoff today. I promised a concise follow-up that lays out how we'll approach cost/perf tuning during the onboarding window. The three pillars we'll iterate on during the first 6 weeks are: batching behavior, KV/prefix caching, and quantization profile selection, with routing policies layered on top to preserve latency SLOs.

Attached is a short runbook (scubatech-cost-steering-runbook-v1.pdf) and the live-routing matrix we'll use to map traffic -> model variant in low/high load. High level plan:
- Week 0 (setup): baseline perf run + token-level cost snapshot
- Weeks 1–3: batching & cache experiments (A/B small knobs)
- Weeks 4–5: quantization profiles and validation on sample prompts
- Week 6: rollout to production with canary routing rules and fallback variants

Immediate asks for your side:
1) Confirm 1–2 representative prompt sets (privacy-filtered) by EOD Mon (attachment: live-routing-matrix.xlsx includes sample buckets).
2) Approve a 2-hour window for initial baseline runs (we recommend Tue 6/20 03:00–05:00 PT).

Karthik and Stephanie will own the experiment cadence and measurement hooks. I'll own cross-team coordination and the rollout checklist.

If that timeline looks tight for you, tell us the constraints and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to shipping this smoothly.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scubatech-cost-steering-runbook-v1.pdf (PDF, 2 pages), live-routing-matrix.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

From: Elena Morales <elena@scubatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, infraops@scubatech.com
Date: 2028-06-16T20:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Cost-steering plan & live-routing runbook for ScubaTech onboarding

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear plan. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
1) Prompt sets — we can provide two sanitized sets: 
   - customer_support_samples (200 prompts)
   - product_qa_short (400 prompts)
   ETA: Wed 6/21 EOD.
2) Baseline window — Tue 6/20 03:00–05:00 PT works, but our on-call infra lead (cc'ed) wants the tests to avoid the nightly batch job that runs at 03:30. Can you shift to 05:30–07:30 PT if that's still OK?
3) For quantization validation, can you document the regression thresholds you're comfortable with (latency P95 delta, quality hit as measured by our eval harness)? We need to align on rollback criteria.

We reviewed the routing matrix briefly — thanks for including the fallback lanes. We'll review and provide comments on Thurs.

—Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Platform Engineering, ScubaTech
elena@scubatech.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@scubatech.com>, infraops@scubatech.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-17T02:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Cost-steering plan & live-routing runbook for ScubaTech onboarding

Elena —

Thanks — quick answers inline.

1) Prompt sets: perfect, two samples are ideal. We'll start with a 10% sample subset for initial runs to reduce cost and then scale once stable.

2) Baseline window: shifting to 05:30–07:30 PT is fine. We will avoid the 03:30 batch job. Please confirm final window and we'll book infra for that slot.

3) Quantization/rollback thresholds (proposal):
   - Latency: P95 increase <= 15% vs baseline for canary traffic (if >15% we fail and rollback)
   - Quality: automated eval F1/QA accuracy drop <= 2 points on your product_qa_short harness; if drop >2 points we hold and run manual review
   - Cost: expected per-token compute reduction >= 20% for the chosen quantization profile (we won't proceed if <10%)

Operational notes:
- We'll run canaries at 5% traffic targeting the quantized variant with an automatic 10-minute health check (latency and error-rate).
- Routing policy matrix will include region-awareness (us-east primary, fallback to us-west) and a cost-tier rule: prefer quantized variant when upstream load >70% to preserve capacity.

I'll upload a short checklist and the experiment scaffolding to the shared drive (link below). Stephanie will coordinate the telemetry hooks.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cScubaTechOnboard

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@scubatech.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: infraops@scubatech.com
Date: 2028-06-18T18:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Cost-steering plan & live-routing runbook for ScubaTech onboarding

All —

Confirmed on our side:
- Baseline run moved to Tue 6/20 05:30–07:30 PT (booked).
- Karthik's thresholds look good to me; we'll publish them in the runbook and the rollout checklist.
- Attachments: I pushed an updated PDF with the exact canary gating and a DocuSign placeholder for our mutual test plan (docu-sign-mtp.pdf). Please review the runbook's rollback checklist (page 2) and add comments in the Drive by EOD Mon 6/19.

Next steps / owners:
- Elena / infraops: upload sanitized prompt sets by Wed EOD (Elena to confirm).
- Stephanie: add telemetry hooks for token-level cost + P95 latency on the shared dashboard before baseline run.
- Karthik: final experiment scaffolding and quant profiles uploaded by Mon 6/19.
- Marissa: coordinate post-baseline retrospective and next experiment window.

If anyone needs a quick sync, I have 30 minutes free Mon 6/19 09:00–09:30 PT. Otherwise we'll proceed on the timeline above.

Thanks everyone — excited to get this into steady state.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: scubatech-cost-steering-runbook-v1.pdf, live-routing-matrix.xlsx, docu-sign-mtp.pdf
